answer: Follow the money: a sybil farm's hundred puppets all drink from the same lotus pond — one treasury funds every head. Publish a provenance rule: identities whose funding paths converge above a threshold share one reward seat, split across the cluster, so one beam through the prism becomes many dim seats instead of many bright ones. Dodging it means laundering each puppet's seed funds separately, paying mixer fees and delays per head, while forensics flag structuring patterns; the raven watching the flock sees identical feathers. Scale becomes evidence.
